article_snippet_en: A physics-informed neural network (DeepXDE) solves the steady 2D advection-dispersion equation with a Poiseuille profile (Pe = 10.0), while an independent time-marching finite-difference solver provides the cross-validation (relative L2 error of 1.34 +/- 0.00% over 5 runs). The magnetically intensified dispersion (kappa = 8, TRIZ principle 24) reduces the mixing length from 0.13 mm to 0.03 mm, i.e. the mixing time from 1.29 s to 0.26 s (gain of 79.7 +/- 0.0%), without any increase in driving pressure.
